propositions: Jira mutations currently lack centralized coordination, resulting in scattered retry ownership across differ, apply wrapper, ACLI/REST, DC SDK, handlers, and batch orchestration with unstable per-ticket versus batch failure scope

A provider-neutral coordinator must enforce a three-call/15-second per-logical-postcondition budget with two sequential fallback delays (2s then 4s) and defer long waits via retry_not_before rather than retry early

An endpoint-failure scoped fuse must trigger after three consecutive exhausted eligible outcomes across at least two tickets, distinct from the existing per-pass blast-radius guard and retained unchanged
Create operations must use label-first containment (rebar-id:<local_id>), optional property second, with safety-abort using known key if local persistence fails

Live external integration testing must pass end-to-end against both ephemeral Jira DC (full multi-issue reconcile) and shared Jira Cloud (bounded to uniquely-labeled self-cleaning throwaway issues) with real transports and credentials before epic close
